about: A text annotation in an inline format (chapter 2 § 2.5.3): text inside an inline format is a $ref to a text format. Invalid: the input referral_letter's inline format declares "contentMediaType": "text/plain". Valid: { "type": "string" }.
sentences: Input 'referral_letter''s inline format declares contentMediaType; text inside an inline format is a $ref to a text format.
